TMC MP Mahua Moitra faces protest with eggs and black flags

Trinamool Congress MP Mahua Moitra was met with protests in West Bengal, where a BJP worker showed her black flags and threw eggs. Moitra accused BJP supporters of targeting her party office and alleged police inaction. The incident occurred shortly after the Calcutta High Court took a strict stance on egg-throwing incidents.
